CustomField.description: True when the guardian acknowledged the post-creation security receipt ("You created Maya's parent-managed profile"). Kept separate from Guardian_Attested__c because the wizard attestation is the consent artifact and switch access must never wait on this second confirmation. Its purpose is detection: an unacknowledged receipt paired with a "This wasn't me" report is what surfaces a profile created by the wrong adult.
CustomField.label: Guardian Echo Confirmed
